Delightful dinner!
Sep 2020
I and my friends came here for dinner as suddenly we wanted to eat sashimi. The restaurant creates a really Japanese atmosphere with its design, furniture, staff uniform, food decoration.
We ordered a lot of dishes and I loved their udon a lot. The taste of the udon soup is soooo niceeee! The sashimi plate's quite fresh too. However the gyoza's fillings not much nice as i thought, felt like it lacked of something.
I wanted to order Japanese green tea - a signature tea in Japan but they dont have it in the menu. However, the restaurant provided free VNese tea.

The price is normal for a Japanese restaurant with such a high quality food. I love to come back again! :D
